label: misaligned
reason: The root requires CompactSpace E for its real normed ambient vector space. Such a vector space is trivial, so it admits no injective circle embedding on the nonempty time window. The source requires compactness of the embedded source manifold and allows ordinary noncompact Euclidean ambient spaces. Thus the formal hypotheses exclude the intended nontrivial applications.
review_scope: The bound isotopy-extension target specialized to a circle source and a finite-dimensional real ambient vector space.
